title: Role — PostgreSQL
description: Any service's PostgreSQL, read by the host collector's postgresql receiver (portablevps.postgres.metrics.enable): connections, transactions, cache hit, scans, tables and dead rows, checkpoints, and the postgres container's log. Pick the service at the top; links can pass ?var-service=<name>.

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Open backends across all databases as a share of max_connections (the metrics reader's own connection included).

panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: Committed plus rolled-back transactions per second.

panels.title: Rollback share (range)
panels.description: Share of transactions over the range that rolled back. Some frameworks roll back read-only transactions by design; watch for a change, not a level.

panels.title: Cache hit (range)
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers over the range. Healthy OLTP is above 99%; no reads at all shows no value.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: On-disk size of every database the receiver reads.

panels.title: Deadlocks (range)
panels.description: Deadlocks Postgres detected and broke by aborting a transaction, over the range. Should be zero.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open backends per database against the cluster's max_connections.

panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions. Rollbacks climbing while commits stay flat points at failing statements.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Shared-buffer hits over all block reads. Sustained under 99% means the working set no longer fits in memory.

panels.title: Tuple activity / s
panels.description: Rows read and written. 'returned' far above 'fetched' means sequential scans read rows they then discard.

panels.title: Scans / s
panels.description: Index against sequential scans over all tables. Sequential scans on small tables are fine; a rising share on a growing table usually means a missing index.

panels.title: Deadlocks, temp files & checkpoints
panels.description: Deadlocks should stay at zero; a temp file is a sort or hash that spilled past work_mem; requested checkpoints include those a backup forces.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: On-disk size per database.

panels.title: Largest tables
panels.description: Ten largest tables (heap and TOAST, without indexes).

panels.title: Dead rows
panels.description: Dead tuples awaiting vacuum, top 10 tables. A table that keeps growing here is not vacuumed fast enough.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (postgresql_database_name, postgresql_table_name) (postgresql_rows_ratio{service_name="$service", host_name=~"$host", state="dead"})) > 0

panels.title: Tables (selected range)
panels.description: Every table the receiver reads: size, live and dead rows now; row writes, sequential scans and vacuums over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (postgresql_database_name, postgresql_table_name) (postgresql_rows_ratio{service_name="$service", host_name=~"$host", state="dead"}) / clamp_min(sum by (postgresql_database_name, postgresql_table_name) (postgresql_rows_ratio{service_name="$service", host_name=~"$host"}), 1)

panels.title: Row writes per table / s
panels.description: Inserts (ins), updates (upd, hot_upd: those that needed no index change) and deletes (del) per table, top 10 series.

panels.title: Sequential scans per table / s
panels.description: Tables read by sequential scan, top 10. A large table near the top is the index to add.

panels.title: Largest indexes
panels.description: Ten largest indexes.

panels.title: Buffers written / s
panels.description: Buffers written by checkpoints and by the background writer.

panels.title: Checkpoint time
panels.description: Share of wall time spent writing and syncing checkpoints. A sync share that grows means the disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Buffers allocated / s
panels.description: New buffers allocated in shared buffers: how fast the working set moves through memory.

panels.title: Postgres container
panels.description: CPU and memory of the service's postgres container(s), from podman stats. Empty when PostgreSQL does not run in a container named postgres*.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: PostgreSQL log lines per level (LOG, ERROR, FATAL, …), read from the message prefix. The postgres container of the selected service, all hosts.

targets.expr: service.name:="$service" AND CONTAINER_NAME:~"^postgres" | extract "] <level>:" | filter level:~"^[A-Z]+$" | stats by (level) count() lines

panels.title: Errors & warnings
panels.description: ERROR, FATAL, PANIC and WARNING lines. The statement that caused an error follows on its own STATEMENT line in the full log below.

panels.title: PostgreSQL log
panels.description: Everything the postgres container logged: checkpoints, connections refused, slow or failing statements.
